xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4959: Overdeck Anywhere: account management page (plan, relay add-on and allowance, machines, billing portal, delete account)

plan.title: Overdeck Anywhere: account management page (plan, relay add-on and allowance, machines, billing portal, delete account)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: About 30 files, almost all in services/account and its tests: the web session, the page, its two actions and the Directory DO paths they read are one user-visible feature that cannot ship in parts (a page without its data source or its delete is incomplete). The separable dashboard half was already split out to PAN-4960.

narratives.Problem: A signed-in Overdeck Anywhere user has nowhere to see their plan, relay use or machines, remove a machine or delete their account. services/account serves only sign-in and the owner's /admin; machines and relay use live only in the connect service's per-account Durable Object.
narratives.Proposal: Phase 1, read-only, for invite-allowlisted testers: a server-rendered /account page on account.overdeck.ai behind a new user web session (migration 0002, purpose 'account'), reading machines and relay use from connect's AccountDirectory Durable Object through a cross-script DIRECTORY binding. The DO gains internal paths /account-view, /remove-machine and /delete-account. Remove revokes the machine's device token and forgets it; Delete is a typed-login two-step that also clears directory data as a new deletion data holder. Billing, upgrade and Add 50 GB show 'Paid plans are invite-only for now.' with no prices.
narratives.NonGoals:
- The dashboard Settings → Anywhere Account card, PKCE Sign in button and Manage account link (PAN-4960)
- Checkout, upgrade/downgrade, relay add-on toggle, Add 50 GB, Creem customer portal, prices or lapse rules (phase 2, PAN-4294)
- Hosted vault storage use and the storage add-on (PAN-4297)
- Listing or removing phones (clients) on the page
- Renaming machines or devices on the page, or listing account-service devices that never joined the directory
- Recording pending attempts from the account page sign-in
- A service binding from the account Worker to the connect Worker (cycle)
- Any deploy, secret or live D1 change (operator only)

autoDecisions.summary: Split the dashboard Account card and PKCE sign-in into sibling issue PAN-4960
autoDecisions.rationale: The two halves share no code and together exceed one plan's size limits; each ships and is reviewed on its own. Recorded on PAN-4959 as a comment.

autoDecisions.summary: Read machines and relay use through a cross-script Durable Object binding (script_name overdeck-connect)
autoDecisions.rationale: Connect already binds account via a service binding; a binding back would be a cycle Cloudflare does not document as deployable, while cross-script DO bindings are a documented pattern.

autoDecisions.summary: Remove revokes the machine's device token and then forgets it in the directory
autoDecisions.rationale: Forgetting alone lets an offline machine re-register on its next hello, so the free slot would not stay free.

autoDecisions.summary: Add the directory as an account-deletion data holder
autoDecisions.rationale: Makes the page's deletion statement true: today nothing hosted is deleted while the DO keeps labels, keys, push tokens and sealed inbox events.

autoDecisions.summary: The account page sign-in records no pending attempts and lets expired-grant users in
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors GET /v1/me (expired users can still see status and delete) and avoids a second pending_attempts CHECK migration; invitations keep coming from device and PKCE sign-ins.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete account needs the GitHub login typed on a confirm page
autoDecisions.rationale: Deletion is irreversible and the page has no JavaScript, so a two-step form is the safe confirmation.

autoDecisions.summary: Phones are not listed in phase 1
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names machines only; phones already have removal paths in the app and on machines.

items.title: Directory DO answers GET /account-view with machines and relay status

expected_outputs: account-view.test.ts and the connect miniflare test pass

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4959.md WI-1. Create services/connect/src/account-view.ts exporting ACCOUNT_PATHS {view:'/account-view', removeMachine:'/remove-machine', deleteAccount:'/delete-account'}, the AccountViewMachine/AccountView types and the pure accountView(state, online, now, capBytes) builder (machines in state order with ISO lastSeenAt and deviceId; relay = relayStatusOf(state.relay, now, capBytes)). In DirectoryHost.fetch (services/connect/src/directory.ts, next to the INTERNAL.inbox branch) answer GET ACCOUNT_PATHS.view with json(accountView(this.state, set of this.registered() environment ids, this.deps.now(), relayCapBytes(this.env.RELAY_CAP_BYTES))). Unit-test the builder; integration-test the path through (await mf.getDurableObjectNamespace('DIRECTORY')).get(ns.idFromName(userId)).fetch('https://directory/account-view').

items.title: Given two stored machines with one open socket, when accountView runs, then it returns both machines oldest first with online true for the connected one and false for the other
Given a relay_usage row from the previous UTC month, when accountView runs, then relay.bytesUsed is 0 and stopped is false; a row for this month at the cap returns stopped true
Given two machines registered on real workerd, when the test fetches https://directory/account-view on the account's DO stub, then the response is 200 JSON listing both machines with online true
Directory DO removes a machine on POST /remove-machine without a calling socket

expected_outputs: directory-state.test.ts and the connect miniflare test pass

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 and D-5. Add DirectoryEvent kind 'remove-machine' {environmentId} and a removeMachine reducer (copy of the 'forget' effects minus every send/close to 'self'; broadcast with withOnline(ctx.online, null, target); close the target with CONNECT_CLOSE_CODES.forgotten). In DirectoryHost change apply/context/execute/resolve to accept self: WebSocket | null: resolve(null,'self') = [], resolve(null,'all'|'others') = every registered machine socket; the five self-using execute cases (inbox-create, fetch-turn, deliver-push, register-client, register) start with if (!self) break. fetch answers POST ACCOUNT_PATHS.removeMachine: JSON {environmentId} string 1-64 chars else 400 {error:'bad_request'}; unknown id 404 {error:'unknown_machine'}; else apply(null, event) and 200 {removed:true}.

items.title: Given a known machine, when reduce handles remove-machine, then the effects contain delete-machine, inbox-forget, a directory frame to others and clients without the machine, a close 4012 to that machine, and no send to 'self'
Given an unknown environment id, when reduce handles remove-machine, then it returns the state unchanged and only a log effect with outcome unknown_machine

Given a free account with 3 connected machines on real workerd, when POST /remove-machine names machine 1, then machine 1's socket closes 4012, machine 2 receives a directory frame listing 2 machines, and a new fourth environment's hello receives welcome instead of close 4009
Given a body without a string environmentId, when POST /remove-machine runs, then it returns 400 {error:'bad_request'}
Directory DO empties itself on POST /delete-account

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 and D-6. account-view.ts exports ACCOUNT_TABLES = ['machines','meta','approvals','relay_usage','clients','inboxes','inbox_events']. DirectoryHost.fetch answers POST ACCOUNT_PATHS.deleteAccount: safeClose every socket from this.ctx.getWebSockets(MACHINE_TAG) with CONNECT_CLOSE_CODES.unauthorized reason 'account deleted', DELETE FROM each table, await this.ctx.storage.deleteAlarm(), set this.state = EMPTY_DIRECTORY, answer 200 {deleted:true}. Do not call storage.deleteAll() (the schema is created only in the constructor).

items.title: Given a connected machine and a connected phone, when POST /delete-account runs, then both sockets close with code 4001
Given a DO with machines, an inbox and relay usage, when POST /delete-account runs, then a following GET /account-view returns machines [] and relay.bytesUsed 0
Given an already emptied DO, when POST /delete-account runs again, then it returns 200 {deleted:true}

expected_outputs: every account unit test and the account miniflare test pass

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4, D-7, D-8, D-9. Add migrations/0002_account_page.sql exactly as in the PRD (user_sessions table + index; rebuild auth_requests with purpose CHECK including 'account'; no semicolons in comments). Purpose union gains 'account'; resolveSignIn flow becomes SignInFlow | null (null skips recordPendingAttempt). New account-page/session.ts mirrors admin/session.ts: ACCOUNT_COOKIE '__Host-od_account', 12 h TTL, signInPage, login (Origin check then startGitHubLeg(rc,'account',{})), grants.ts gains getGrant(rc, githubId) returning the grants row whether or not it expired (same SELECT as getActiveGrant without the expiry clause). onGitHubIdentity with the PRD's order (deleting -> 403 'This account is being deleted.'; isAllowed -> resolveSignIn(...,null) -> session; existing users row + expired grants row -> session; else inviteOnlyPage()), onGitHubDenied, requireUserSession (csrf + Origin on POSTs, users.deleted_at IS NULL; access is revoked when the user is not the owner and getGrant returns null), logout. Register the purpose in github-callback defaultHandlers. Add rate buckets 'account-login' (10/10 min) and 'account-action' (30/15 min). routes.ts rows: GET /account (temporary identity page), POST /account/login, POST /account/logout; replace the stale 'never edit this file' header sentence. maintenance.ts purges expired user_sessions. Update schema.test.ts (both migration files, user_sessions in TABLES, purpose 'account' accepted and 'bogus' refused), maintenance.test.ts (user_sessions key), the account miniflare test (apply every migrations/*.sql in name order), and add helpers/account.ts makeAccountClient.

Account Worker reads and changes the Directory DO through a cross-script DIRECTORY binding

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5, D-2, D-11. env.ts Env gains optional DIRECTORY?: DurableObjectNamespace with the PRD comment. wrangler.jsonc gains durable_objects.bindings [{name:'DIRECTORY', class_name:'AccountDirectory', script_name:'overdeck-connect'}] (no migrations entry) and a comment that overdeck-connect deploys first. New directory-view.ts declares structural DirectoryMachine/DirectoryView types (no import from services/connect) and readDirectoryView (null when unbound, on throw, non-200 or failed shape check), removeDirectoryMachine ('removed' | 'unknown' | 'unavailable' for 200 / 404 / anything else or throw) and deleteDirectoryAccount (throws Error('directory delete failed: HTTP <status>') on non-200); each uses env.DIRECTORY.get(env.DIRECTORY.idFromName(userId)).fetch('https://directory<path>'). Implementation checkpoint: if build:dry fails because of the cross-script binding, stop and report with pan tell instead of changing the binding shape.

items.title: Given env without DIRECTORY, when readDirectoryView runs, then it returns null without throwing
Given a fake namespace whose stub answers 200 with a valid view, when readDirectoryView runs, then it returns the parsed machines and relay; a malformed body or a 500 returns null

Account page renders identity, plan, relay use, machines and billing text

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6. New account-page/page.ts with renderAccountPage(rc, session, notice?) and the GET /account handler (no session -> signInPage(); revoked access -> signInPage('Access to this account was removed.') and delete the session row). Sections in order with the PRD's exact headings and strings: h1 'Your Overdeck account' + 'Signed in as <login> (GitHub id <id>)' + Sign out form; Plan (Free account / Tester from entitlementFor(getGrant(...)) so an expired grant keeps its own plan, owner with no row shows Tester; expiry text from that row's expires_at: 'No expiry', the date, or 'Expired on <date>'; 'Paid plans are invite-only for now.'); Relay (tester usage line + 'Resets on <YYYY-MM-01> (UTC).' + cap message when stopped; free 'The relay is not included in the free account.'); Machines (count line '<n> of 3 machines' on free, '<n> machines' on tester; table Label/Status/Last seen/Version with a Remove form per row posting to /account/machines/<environmentId>/remove with csrf; the D-3 note under the table); Billing ('Billing is not available yet. Paid plans are invite-only for now.'); Delete account (FR-9 statement + form posting to /account/delete). Unavailable view -> 'Machines and relay use are unavailable right now.' in Relay and Machines and no Remove forms. Every value through escapeHtml; no '$' anywhere. Point routes.ts GET /account at it.

POST /account/delete (bucket account-action, csrf + Origin) renders the confirm page: FR-9 statement, input name='confirm', csrf field, 'Delete my account' button posting to /account/delete/confirm, 'Cancel' link to /account.
